lines.en: I beat my wings over the treetops.
I glide a stretch through the air.
I circle above the canopy.

lines.zh: 我从天上落下来，没摔着。
lines.en: I drop from the sky and don't fall hard.
I fly low over the clearing.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上一闪而过。
lines.en: My shadow flicks across the ground.
I dive your way.
I fly over the dark forest; the wind is cold.
I fold my wings and slide down slowly.
I land on a branch, and it bends.
I come down from the clouds, slowly.

lines.zh: 我在诡异森林上空转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle above the strange forest.

lines.zh: 我在枝头停着，翅膀收着。
lines.en: I perch with my wings folded.

lines.zh: 我蹲在枝上，翼膜收得很紧。
lines.en: I crouch on the branch, wings folded tight.

lines.zh: 叶子一晃，我就知道风的方向。
lines.en: When the leaves shift, I know which way the wind blows.
My long neck turns slowly.

lines.zh: 我把长颈转过去，看林间空隙。
lines.en: I turn my long neck to study a gap in the trees.
The wind snaps my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 我记得从上面看你的样子。
lines.en: I remember how you looked from above.
I shift to my other foot.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，藏在翼下。
lines.en: I lower my head under my wing.
I wait for the light to fail a little more.
In the dark my eyes glow red.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一截枯枝。
lines.en: I hold still like a dead branch.
I try to call, and my throat is hollow.
I'm gauging the treetops.
You have to look up at me.

lines.zh: 我的影子刚才在你头上。
lines.en: My shadow was over your head just now.

lines.zh: 你听见翅膀的声音了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the wings?
I came down to look at you.

lines.zh: 你的味道在风里很明显。
lines.en: Your scent is plain on the wind.

lines.zh: 抬头看一眼就好，别看我第二眼。
lines.en: One glance up will do; don't look twice.
I tilt my head at your hands.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我还在看你。
lines.en: You step back twice; I'm still watching.
My claws are longer than your arm.
You stand in the open; easy to find.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，林子里静了。
lines.en: I call once, and the wood goes silent.

lines.zh: 我收着翅膀，不代表我飞不了。
lines.en: Folded wings don't mean I can't fly.

lines.zh: 你举着的那点光，让我眯眼。
lines.en: That small light you hold makes me squint.
I don't like where you're standing.

lines.zh: 我从枝上看你，你没察觉。
lines.en: I watch you from the branch; you haven't noticed.
Where you are is noted.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜破了一个小口。
lines.en: A small tear in my wing membrane.
I beat my wings to dodge upward.

lines.zh: 我一只爪趾被砸得发麻。
lines.en: One of my talons has gone numb.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，发出长长的啸。
lines.en: I open my maw and let out a long shriek.
I land on a branch and steady.
I shake, and feathers drift down.
I growl, a sound in my throat.

lines.zh: 我挂在枝上，翼膜抖个不停。
lines.en: I hang on the branch, my wing membrane shivering.
My grip loosened a little.
My membranes can still lift me.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，我看到了。
lines.en: I see that meat in your hand.
The wind carries the smell up.
I angle down a little.
Raise it; I can see it clearly.
The smell of meat makes me hungry.
I stand up on the branch.
Step back two paces and I'll come down.
That smell of blood is fresh.
I spread my wings and descend slowly.
Just set it down.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀压低，慢慢沉下去。
lines.en: I lower my wings and sink down slowly.
From here I see you clearly.
You hit my wing and bounce off.

lines.zh: 我从上方压下来，你退开。
lines.en: I press down from above; you dodge.
My claws graze your shoulder.
I land beside you, and the wind is strong.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，羽毛和尘一起飞。
lines.en: We collide, feathers and dust together.
I pull back and beat my wings again.
I sweep over your head.

lines.zh: 你的箭射到我的翼膜，弹开。
lines.en: Your arrow strikes my membrane and glances off.
I turn, and my wingtip sweeps you.
You step back; only then do I land.
Another descends from the clouds.
Her wing membrane is wider than mine.
We perch on the same branch.
Her long neck leans against mine.
We circle together, slowly.
There's a little blood on her claws.

lines.zh: 我们一起俯冲，一前一后。
lines.en: We dive, one behind the other.
She calls once in the wind.

lines.zh: 我们在同一股上升风里并排。
lines.en: We ride the same updraft side by side.
Two shadows, one sky.
I snatch a sheep and take off.

lines.zh: 我把你的盾抓出几道痕。
lines.en: I claw a few lines into your shield.

lines.zh: 我从地上抓起你的帽子。
lines.en: I snatch your hat off the ground.
I drag my kill to the treetop.
I bite your arrow and snap it.
I hook a piece of meat with a claw.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的武器丢进林子。
lines.en: I drop your fallen weapon into the woods.
I snatch a cloth and let it fall.
I toss the bone away.
I tear your cloak.
I saw you from above.

lines.zh: 你走过空地，我数着你的步。
lines.en: You cross the clearing; I count your steps.
I fold my wings and prepare to drop.
Your position is good: open.
I've started sliding down.
It saw me before I saw it.
From this height my dive is true.
I take this downdraft.
You looked up; too late.
I needn't run to reach you.
It's beneath me; it can't escape.
I spread my wings to full span.
I wheel above your head.
You hide behind a tree; I circle it.
I drop below the canopy.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的影就挪一格。
lines.en: Each step you take moves my shadow a block.
Listen; the wingbeats are closer.
I've worked out the wind.
You're in the open; no escape.
I fold my wings and drop straight.
You looked up again.
I let go of the branch, talons pointing down.

lines.zh: 我停在一棵高树上等你。
lines.en: I wait in a tall tree.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就在枝上等着。
lines.en: You hold still, so I wait on the branch.
I rake down from above.
My claws close on your shoulder.
Death Claw swings out.

lines.zh: 我一记俯冲撞在你背上。
lines.en: I dive into your back.
I bite the rim of your armor.
I whip my head and lift you a block.
My wing sweeps past, the wind heavy.

lines.zh: 我一爪拍下去，把它按进土。
lines.en: I drive a claw down and pin it to the dirt.
I land on it and pin it.
That came in low along the ground.
It retreats; I rise again.
My claws sink into its plate.
I come out of the clouds.

lines.zh: 林子上面有风，我借着风。
lines.en: There's wind above the wood; I ride it.

lines.zh: 我落在一棵高树的顶上。
lines.en: I land atop a tall tree.
The trees here are tall enough.

lines.zh: 我拍了两下翅膀，抖掉水。
lines.en: I beat my wings twice to shake off water.

lines.zh: 我从树冠里出来，风在翼下。
lines.en: I come out of the canopy with wind under my wings.

lines.zh: 我先在草上投下一片影。
lines.en: I cast a patch of shadow on the grass first.
I slowly spread my membranes.
The air here smells good.
I've perched a long while.
I beat my wings and sink lower.

lines.zh: 林子忽然静了，我先落一枝。
lines.en: The woods go quiet; I land on a branch first.

lines.zh: 火燎到翼膜，我猛地拉升。
lines.en: Fire catches my membrane; I climb hard.
I fall and crash into the brush.

lines.zh: 水糊住我的翼，我挣着往上。
lines.en: Water mats my wings; I struggle up.
The blast spins me.

lines.zh: 箭穿进翼膜，留下一个孔。
lines.en: An arrow punches a hole in my membrane.
A light binds my wings.
Hunger makes my wingbeats uneven.

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，我差点掉下去。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and I nearly drop.
There's no wind in this sky.
